## Description

A concise description of what the bug is.

## Component Affected

Name of the component or token (e.g. `Button`, `NavigationMenu`, `theme-studio`).

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Observe error behaviour

## Expected Behaviour

A clear description of what you expected to happen according to our design engineering invariants.

## Actual Behaviour

What actually occurred instead (e.g. layout shift, focus trap failure, contrast violation).

## Environment

- OS: [e.g. macOS 15, Windows 11, iOS 18]
- Browser: [e.g. Safari 18, Chrome 130, Firefox 132]
- Node version: [e.g. 20.18.0]
- React version: [e.g. 19.3.1]

## Additional Context

Add any other screenshots, screen recordings, or context about the issue here.
